## Workflow package

Create identity-preserving Hearts of Iron IV-style leader portraits from source
photographs with FLUX.2 Klein 9B and ComfyUI.

The package contains three workflows:

- **Source portrait** — crop and prepare a photograph, then create three
  independently adjustable portrait candidates.
- **Text to image** — create a fictional portrait from a written person
  description.
- **Portrait processing** — crop, upscale, and optionally restore a source
  image before styling.

Editor workflows and matching API-format graphs are included. Model weights
are downloaded separately by the installers.

## Downloads

- **Model-free ZIP** — workflows, documentation, installers, and bundled assets.
- **Windows x64 executable** — self-extracting version of the same package.
- **RunPod runtime archive** — only the files required to install and run the
  workflows on an existing ComfyUI pod.

## Before installation

Accept the [FLUX.2 Klein base 9B FP8 agreement](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-base-9b-fp8)
and create a [read-only Hugging Face token](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens/new?tokenType=read).

The RunPod command expects ComfyUI at
`/workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI`. If your pod uses another location, set
`COMFY_ROOT` to the directory containing `main.py`.

## RunPod installation

Run this in the RunPod web terminal:

```bash
(
set -euo pipefail
export HF_TOKEN="hf_..."
COMFY_ROOT=/workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI
RUNTIME_DIR=/workspace/hoi4-portrait-runpod
test -f "$COMFY_ROOT/main.py" || { echo "ComfyUI not found at $COMFY_ROOT; set COMFY_ROOT to the folder containing main.py."; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR"
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/klimPaskov/comfyui-hoi4-portraits/releases/latest/download/HOI4-Portrait-RunPod.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$RUNTIME_DIR"
"$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/install_runpod.sh" "$COMFY_ROOT"
)
```

Restart ComfyUI after installation, then open a workflow from
**Workflows → hoi4_portraits**.
